mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245).
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 104.5 and CPIAUCSL > 245, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 245, it indicates elevated inflation that triggers monetary tightening and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 245, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment level (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises and the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 245, it signals aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 245, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units signals potential overheating and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200 and the economy is in late-cycle, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
